statement: ∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), (if k.Prime then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0)) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/200

plain_statement.zh: 只计素数，给等差数列的误差留出 n/200
plain_statement.en: Bound the prime-only progression error by n/200

brief.zh: 对素数有 Λ(p)=log p。BMOR 定理 1.2 控制 q≥3；q=2 用模 4 的两个奇剩余类，q=1 再加素数 2。保留阈值 10¹⁶。
brief.en: Use Λ(p)=log p and Theorem 1.2 for q ≥ 3. For q=2 combine both odd classes modulo four. For q=1 also include the prime two. Keep the explicit threshold.
